_comment: Design lock repeated in every image prompt for this character.
name: Rook
lock: Same character as the attached reference image: Rook, a tall, lean woman in her mid-twenties with sharp features and a pale scar along her jaw. Same long dark hair in a braid with a silver band, hanging behind her head. Same knee-length oxblood fighting coat with gold embroidery at the collar, cuffs and hem, torn and patched, the coat tails split at the back. Same brown leather belt with a gold buckle, dark trousers, dark boots, and cloth wraps on her hand and shins. She has NO right arm and NO right hand in any pose: the empty right sleeve is pinned up at the shoulder with a gold pin. Same colours as the reference.
